events.name: Germany Ifo Business Climate
events.description: Survey of German firms' current conditions and expectations; a leading indicator for Eurozone's largest economy.

events.name: US Dallas Fed Manufacturing Index
events.description: Texas factory activity survey; an early read on US manufacturing conditions ahead of national data.

events.name: US CB Consumer Confidence
events.description: Conference Board survey of household sentiment on jobs and business conditions; guides consumer spending outlook.

events.name: US Durable Goods Orders (M-o-M)
events.description: Monthly change in new orders for long-lasting manufactured goods; signals business investment and factory demand.

events.name: US Fed Interest Rate Decision
events.description: FOMC announces the federal funds target range; the key driver of global rates, the dollar and risk assets.

events.name: Canada BoC Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Bank of Canada sets its overnight policy rate, shaping CAD and North American rate expectations.

events.name: US GDP (Q-o-Q, Advance Q3)
events.description: First estimate of annualized US economic growth for Q3; the broadest gauge of activity and growth momentum.

events.name: ECB Interest Rate Decision
events.description: ECB sets the deposit facility rate for the Eurozone, steering euro rates amid energy-driven inflation risks.

events.name: Eurozone GDP (Q-o-Q, Flash Q3)
events.description: Preliminary quarterly change in Eurozone output; shows how the bloc is coping with energy costs and weak confidence.

events.name: Japan BoJ Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Bank of Japan announces its policy rate and guidance; a major driver of the yen and global yields.
